{{Short description|Swedish physicist (1943–2015)}}
'''Per Olof Hulth''' (2 June 1943 – 26 February 2015) was a Swedish [[astroparticle physics|astroparticle physicist]].

Hulth grew up in [[Stockholm]]. He graduated with a PhD degree in particle physics in 1976 from [[Stockholm University]],<ref>Hulth, Per Olof (1976), ''Strange particle production in 19 GeV/c proton-proton interactions''</ref> the same university where he later for many years was Professor of Experimental Astroparticle Physics and in the late 1990s headed the Department of Physics. Hulth also worked at [[CERN]] in [[Geneva]] and was one of the key European participants in the [[Antarctic Muon And Neutrino Detector Array|AMANDA]] project at the [[South Pole]], as well as its successor experiment [[IceCube]], designed to study [[neutrino]]s from space in the polar cap ice.<ref name="KVA 040429"/> He was spokesperson of the [[IceCube]] collaboration from 2001 to 2005.<ref>[http://www.su.se/pub/jsp/polopoly.jsp?d=536&a=1518 Stockholms universitet: Ett nytt fönster mot universum] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071210153439/http://www.su.se/pub/jsp/polopoly.jsp?d=536&a=1518 |date=2007-12-10 }}, 12 September 2005</ref>

Hulth became a member of the Class for Physics of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] in 2004.<ref name="KVA 040429">[http://www.kva.se/sv/Nyheter/nyheter-2008-2001/Per-Olof-Hulth-invald-i-fysikklassen/ Kungl. Vetenskapsakademien: Per-Olof Hulth invald i fysikklassen] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150227174139/http://www.kva.se/sv/Nyheter/nyheter-2008-2001/Per-Olof-Hulth-invald-i-fysikklassen/ |date=2015-02-27 }}, press release 29 April 2004</ref> He was chairman of the Education Committee of the Royal Academy and a prominent critic of for-profit [[Education in Sweden#Independent schools|independent primary and secondary schools]], calling for a national ban on [[for-profit school]]s in Sweden in 2013.<ref>[[Svenska Dagbladet]]: [http://www.svd.se/opinion/brannpunkt/satt-stopp-for-vinstuttag-i-skolan_8034428.svd Sätt stopp för vinstuttag i skolan], 27 March 2013</ref><ref>Dagens Arena: [http://www.dagensarena.se/innehall/det-fria-skolvalet-underminerar-lararyrkets-status/ ''”Det fria skolvalet underminerar läraryrkets status”''] 27 March 2013</ref>

He was an active member of ''[[Föreningen Vetenskap och Folkbildning]]'', The Swedish Skeptics' Association, and served as its chairman from 1988 to 1998.

Per Olof Hulth was older brother to [[Mats Hulth]], social democratic politician and former Commissioner of Finance of Stockholm Municipality.
